title: To my litol bebi
message: Happy happy birthday to the love of my life! I hope your day is as sweet as you are. You deserve all the best things in life because you’re such a blessing to everyone around you.

In my 25 years, life has never been this exciting, fun, crazy, and full of love. You make everything sparkle, just like how your eyes do when you’re happy or kilig. With your cute smile, you always find a way to make heavy situations feel lighter and bring a new perspective when things get tough. You always have this something that when you're around, everything feels lighter and safer.

I’m so sorry I can’t be home to celebrate with you today, but please remember that I’d travel across the world for you. I hope you keep pursuing your dreams as I’ll always be right here cheering for you and supporting you in building and getting the life that you want. I am so so sooo proud of you, my baby!
I love living and building this crazy, wonderful life with you. Thank you for letting me be a part of yours, baby.
I love and miss you so much, baby! Thank you for everything.
I will always cook you my sinigang! lol
